profile.name: Renata Guimarães

summary.pt: Arquiteta e urbanista com atuação em projetos residenciais, comerciais, institucionais e de habitação social no Brasil, além de colaboração remota com equipes nos Estados Unidos. Desenvolve projetos, documentação técnica e visualizações com Revit e AutoCAD, com atenção às pessoas, ao uso dos espaços e aos detalhes.
summary.en: Architect and urban planner with experience in residential, commercial, institutional and social-housing projects in Brazil, alongside remote collaboration with US-based teams. Her work spans design, technical documentation and visualization using Revit and AutoCAD, with attention to people, spatial use and detail.

experience.scope_pt: Projetos institucionais, layouts, documentação técnica, modelagem em Revit e reformas. Setor de Fiscalização no 6º andar, sala de auditoria no 4º andar, sala de coleta de leite, coworkings de inspetorias em Niterói, Nova Iguaçu, Araruama, Petrópolis e Campo Grande, memoriais e melhorias internas. Planejamento do CREA AQUI 2027.
experience.scope_en: Institutional design, workplace layouts, technical documentation, Revit modeling and renovation proposals. Work includes Inspection Department and audit-room renovations, a milk collection room, regional inspectorate coworking spaces, specifications and internal improvements, and planning for CREA AQUI 2027.

experience.scope_pt: Documentação de projetos residenciais e comerciais em AutoCAD: plantas, elevações, cortes e modelagem 3D selecionada.
experience.scope_en: AutoCAD drawing packages for residential and commercial projects: plans, elevations, sections and selected 3D modeling.

experience.organization: Casa Carioca · Prefeitura do Rio / SEAC
experience.scope_pt: Melhorias habitacionais no Complexo da Maré, em programa envolvendo aproximadamente 300 famílias; levantamentos, projetos e documentação.
experience.scope_en: Housing improvements in Complexo da Maré, within a programme involving around 300 families; field surveys, residential design and technical documentation.

experience.organization: Projeto Na Régua · SEINFRA RJ / UERJ
experience.scope_pt: Coordenação de mais de 170 projetos de melhorias habitacionais, levantamentos, entrevistas e desenho orientado à acessibilidade.
experience.scope_en: Coordination of more than 170 housing-improvement projects, including site assessments, resident interviews and accessibility-focused design.

summary.en: A retro-inspired barbershop bringing together grooming stations, a bar, lounge, menswear retail and a tattoo studio. Exposed brick, custom furnishings and warm lighting connect the spaces through a coherent identity.

context.en: The brief brings several different activities together within a coherent brand experience. Original brickwork anchors an industrial, retro-inspired interior, with custom furnishings and service zones arranged to support comfortable circulation.

summary.en: A clinic renovation and interior fit-out within a shopping centre, bringing together reception, consultation rooms, diagnostics and support areas. The layout prioritizes circulation, accessibility and clinical functions within a compact footprint.

summary.en: An upper-floor workplace renovation for a pharmaceutical sales company. The mezzanine organizes executive, sales, logistics and support spaces, balancing privacy, collaboration and circulation.

summary.en: Architectural technical assistance for social housing, including surveys, design proposals and material reports. The featured case explores a reorganized home with a separate bathroom, bedrooms and safer circulation.

context.pt: O programa oferece assistência técnica gratuita a famílias em situação de vulnerabilidade habitacional. No estudo D001, duas alternativas de projeto reorganizam uma residência para separar o banheiro, criar quartos e melhorar circulação e condições sanitárias. A atuação reúne assistência técnica, projeto e orientação para melhorias habitacionais.
context.en: The programme provides free architectural technical assistance to households facing vulnerable housing conditions. In case study D001, two proposals reorganize a home to provide a separate bathroom, new bedrooms, improved circulation and better sanitary conditions. The scope brings together technical assistance, design and guidance for housing improvements.

summary.en: An academic museum proposal focused on environmental education along Guanabara Bay. Its wave-like roof responds to the waterfront, while the programme brings together an aquarium, exhibitions, an auditorium, a library and learning spaces.
